description:
Product Lead (Generative Media AI)

Location: Based within commutable distance of at least one of our global hubs (London, New York or San Francisco).

 

 Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that is reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models. 

 

The role

You’ll lead Prolific’s strategy to help our customers build and improve the best generative media models in the world. Across image, video and audio, you’ll identify where human expertise, data and evaluation can make the biggest difference, and turn those opportunities into products customers choose repeatedly.

You’ll operate with a general manager’s mindset, setting the direction for our Generative Media business and owning its customer and commercial outcomes. That means making clear choices about where we can win, what we invest in and how we turn our capabilities into lasting value for customers.

 

What you’ll bring to the role

  • A track record of owning and growing a complex B2B or technical product, product line or business.
  • Experience in generative media, multimodal AI, model evaluation, creative tooling or a closely related field, with the credibility to engage sophisticated research and product teams.
  • Strong product and commercial judgment: you can turn ambiguous problems into a focused strategy and balance customer value, growth and economics.
  • Technical and research fluency to challenge assumptions about data, evaluation quality and model behavior, while respecting specialists’ expertise.
  • A habit of regular, direct customer contact and evidence that you turn what you learn into better products.
  • The leadership and communication skills to turn an ambitious strategy into results. You can move from setting direction to resolving the details of a difficult customer problem.

 

    What you’ll be doing in the role 

  • Define our Generative Media strategy: where Prolific can most improve customers’ models, how we differentiate and which opportunities to pursue or stop.
  • Work directly with researchers, product teams and technical buyers to understand their workflows and turn feedback into product decisions.
  • Turn bespoke demand into repeatable datasets and evaluation offerings, validating needs across customers rather than letting individual deals define the roadmap.
  • Own positioning, pricing and packaging so customers understand our value, adopt our products and return as their needs evolve.
  • Stay accountable for quality, reliability and unit economics, ensuring we can deliver on our promises repeatedly and at scale.
  • Set clear priorities and investment choices. Measure success through customer model improvements, adoption, revenue, repeat usage and delivery economics.

 

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

For pay transparency, the base salary range for this full-time role in San Francisco or New York is $220,000 - $300,000 annually.
